summary: A lying core rotation that lowers raised legs side to side under control, training the obliques and abs while the shoulders stay down.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides, palms down.
Raise your legs together until they point at the ceiling, knees straight or bent 90 degrees.
Lower your legs slowly to one side, keeping both shoulders on the floor.
Stop just before your feet touch the floor, then bring them back through the center.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.
mistakes: Dropping the legs to the floor
